metadata.title: Afterwise - wisdom after the fact
metadata.description: Record a decision you have made - AI breaks it down into category, cognitive biases and missed alternatives.

analysisFailed.title: Analysis failed
analysisFailed.body: Couldn't analyze the entry. Open it and retry.

landing.title: Reflect on decisions you've already made
landing.subtitle: Write down a situation and the choice you made. AI breaks it down into categories, cognitive biases and missed alternatives you didn't consider.

guestCard.title: Try as guest
guestCard.description: One free analysis without signing up. Same quality as the real thing.

signupCard.title: Create account
signupCard.description: Email + password. Save your decisions, browse the dashboard, come back to them.

loginCard.title: Already have an account
loginCard.description: Sign in and continue from where you left off.

errors.rateLimit: Too many attempts. Try again in a minute.
errors.alreadyRegistered: An account with this email already exists.
errors.emailNotConfirmed: Confirm your email - we've sent a link.
errors.weakPassword: Password must be at least 6 characters.

guest.banner: Guest mode: one request without signing up. Create an account to keep your history.
guest.limitReached: You've used your guest request. Sign up to continue.

logoutConfirm.title: Sign out?
logoutConfirm.description: Your session will be ended. You can sign in again anytime.

latest.label: Latest decision
latest.emptySubtitle: Create your first entry to see analysis

newCta.title: New entry
newCta.subtitle: Capture a decision - the LLM analyzes it in seconds.

list.title: Decision history
list.subtitle: All decisions you've recorded, with analysis - category, biases, missed alternatives.

empty.title: No entries yet
empty.description: Create your first entry - and the LLM will analyze it, surfacing the category, potential biases and missed alternatives.

emptyFiltered.title: Nothing found
emptyFiltered.description: No entries match the selected filters.

new.title: New entry
new.subtitle: Write down a decision you've already made. Analysis starts immediately and takes a few seconds.
new.hint: Once you submit, the LLM will start the analysis in the background.

situation.label: Situation
situation.title: Describe the situation
situation.description: The context that helps to understand under what conditions you made the decision.
situation.placeholder: For example: a job offer with higher pay but in another city...

decision.label: Decision
decision.title: What did you decide
decision.description: What you actually chose to do (or not do).
decision.placeholder: I accepted the offer and moved...

reasoning.label: Reasoning
reasoning.title: How you justified it (optional)
reasoning.description: What arguments were 'for', which doubts you ignored - anything you remember.
reasoning.placeholder: Higher pay is more important than routine; I believed I'd adapt...

validation.situationMin: Describe the situation in at least 10 characters
validation.decisionMin: Describe the decision in at least 5 characters

new.successBody: Analysis is in progress - it'll appear soon.

processing.title: Analysis in progress…
processing.description: The LLM is working on your entry. The page will update automatically.

notFound.title: Entry not found
notFound.description: It may have been deleted or you don't have access to it.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Breakdown of your decisions by category, the most frequent cognitive biases and activity over time.

empty.title: No data yet
empty.description: Create a few entries - and you'll see the breakdown by category, frequency of cognitive biases and monthly activity.
